libs/message-bus-api/observability.reason: Only the utilities are filled: parsing an error into fields and cleaning the fields of a log line. The domain has no records of its own — what is written lives as the container's output; it has no services of its own — the parsing of refusals and the logger stand at the application itself; the domain does not go outward — the intake receives rather than sends out. The layers will fill up together with the storage of refusals, and until it there is nothing to put into them.
